edges.description: Fibrillin-2 is a component of Bruch's membrane, so a damaging variant is expected to impair its elastic microfibril layer. The step has not been measured in carriers of the disease variant.

In mice, reducing or blocking fibrillin-2 in the eye leads to retinal degeneration with thinning of the outer nuclear layer and reduced ERG amplitudes. The intermediate steps are not known. Both mouse studies report increased retinal TGF-beta when fibrillin-2 is lost, but whether that increase drives the degeneration has not been tested (see discussions).
Outer retinal degeneration centred on the macula is the clinical maculopathy of EOMD. No source describes the macular lesion in patients, so this edge carries no evidence.
Fbn2 knockdown in the adult mouse eye produces a retinopathy of the deep retinal layers with reduced ERG amplitudes, reversed by recombinant fibrillin-2.
edges.limitations: An acquired knockdown in adult wild-type mice, not a heterozygous germline missense variant, and mice have no macula. The retinopathy is described as exudative, which is not documented in EOMD patients.

edges.description: Blocking fibrillin-2 in the eye produces fundus degeneration and outer nuclear layer thinning.
edges.limitations: Antibody blockade in wild-type mice, not a germline variant; mice have no macula, and the short time course does not model an adult-onset dominant disease.

nodes.description: Proposed loss of fibrillin-2-containing elastic microfibrils in Bruch's membrane, the barrier between the retinal pigment epithelium and the choriocapillaris. The authors of the defining report interpret the genetics as evidence that elastin microfibers and Bruch's membrane maintain blood-retina homeostasis. The structure of Bruch's membrane in EOMD patients has not been reported.

nodes.description: Heterozygous rare FBN2 variants, the founding one being p.Glu1144Lys, in fibrillin-2, a structural glycoprotein of elastic microfibrils. The variants are predicted to disrupt fibrillin-2 function, but no study has measured the effect of p.Glu1144Lys on secretion, microfibril assembly or stability, so no functional impact category or activity modifier is recorded.

nodes.description: Adult male mice given an intravitreal AAV expressing an Fbn2 shRNA develop an exudative retinopathy involving the deep retinal layers, with reduced axial length and reduced ERG amplitudes. Repeated intravitreal fibrillin-2 recombinant protein improved retinal thickness and ERG amplitude, most markedly at 0.75 micrograms.
Rare heterozygous FBN2 missense variant identified by exome sequencing in the defining family and shown to segregate with the maculopathy.
